## Summary

Sky UK is a British broadcaster and telecommunications company providing television, broadband, fixed-line and mobile telephone services, founded on 2 November 1990 as British Sky Broadcasting, based at Sky Studios in Isleworth and part of Sky Group, which Comcast owns [1]. The IEEE registry lists 39 MA-L blocks to "SKY UK LIMITED", at Grant Way, Isleworth and at a Brentwood, Essex address [2]. Its equipment includes the Sky Q set-top boxes, which remain Sky's property and are returned when a contract ends, the Sky Glass smart TV, the Sky Stream box, and Sky Broadband routers such as the Sky Q Hub [1], so a MAC in a Sky block is most likely a Sky router or a Sky TV box in a UK home.

The current Sky Max Hub (SR213), launched in 2023, is a dual-band Wi-Fi 6 router on 2.4 and 5 GHz with eight internal antennas and WPA2/WPA3, without 6 GHz [3]. The silicon inside Sky hubs and boxes, the FCC grantee codes and address randomization are not documented by the sources consulted, and no Sky-specific security advisory was reached from this session; nothing is filled in from memory.
